SnowballAttackS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(startPos:Vector3,target:Model) 
	if not target then return end
	
	bullAttackTrack:Play()
	updateBullRotation()
	
	local ball = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Others"):WaitForChild("雪球"):Clone()
	ball.Position = startPos
	ball.Parent = workspace
	
	game.Debris:AddItem(ball,10)
	
	local FlySound = ball:WaitForChild("Fly")
	FlySound:Play()
	
	local snowballSourceKey = "snowball:" .. tostring(os.clock()) .. ":" .. tostring(startPos)
	local hitOnce = false
	local onHit = function()
		if hitOnce then return end
		hitOnce = true
		local impactPosition = ball.Position
		FlySound:Stop()
		checkSnowBallHit(impactPosition)
		playSmash(impactPosition)
		ball.Transparency = 1
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("雪球命中", ball, {
			FallbackPosition = impactPosition,
			SourceKey = snowballSourceKey,
			TargetUserId = target == LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.UserId or nil,
		})
		game.Debris:AddItem(ball,3)
	end
	
	local endPos = target:GetPivot().Position
	local offset = endPos - startPos
	local offsetY = offset.Y
	
	local distance = offset.Magnitude -- 距离
	local duration = distance / 300 -- 运动时长
	--duration = 1
	local t = 0
	local snowfieldFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("雪原")	
	while true do
		local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		
		t += dt
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / duration,0,1)
		local xz = startPos:Lerp(endPos,alpha)
		local y = startPos.Y + offsetY * (1 - math.cos(alpha * HALF_PI))
		local pos = Vector3.new(xz.X,y,xz.Z)
		ball:PivotTo(ball.CFrame.Rotation + pos)
		--ball.Position = pos
		
		if alpha >= 1 then
			onHit()
			break
		else
			local op = OverlapParams.new()
			if snowfieldFolder then
				local shan = snowfieldFolder:FindFirstChild("山")
				if shan then
					op:AddToFilter(shan)
				end
			end
			op:AddToFilter(rootModel)
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged("SnowballDebris")) -- 雪球碎片
			
			op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

			local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos,ball.Size.X,op)
			if #hits > 0 then
				onHit()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(playerWhoTriggered,string.format("Only %s can open it.",ownedPlayer.DisplayName))

	game.Debris:AddItem(box,5)

	box.RootPart.Open:Play()
	box.RootPart.Anchored = true
	local force = 50
	for _,child:BasePart in ipairs(box:GetDescendants()) do
		if box.RootPart == child then continue end
		if child.Name == "中心" then
			child:Destroy()
			continue
		end
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			local basePart:BasePart = child
			basePart.CanTouch = false
			basePart.CanQuery = false
			local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force))

			basePart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

			local WeldConstraint:WeldConstraint = child

			WeldConstraint:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- 创建道具

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(ownedPlayer)

		local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(itemLo.ResItemId)
		if not resItemLo then continue end

			costNum += 1

function getAxeDamage()
	local axeId = v_axeId.Value
	if axeId == 0 then
		axeId = 104
	end
	local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(axeId)
	local param = resLo.param:split(",")

	local damage = tonumber(param[2] or param[1])
	return damage
end

	--print("攻击目标")
	if v_target.Value then
		if v_target.Value:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree) then
			local toolAxe = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if toolAxe then
				toolAxe:Activate()

			-- 砍树
			GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(nil,v_target.Value,getAxeDamage())

				_nextFindTreeTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1
			end

		end
	end

	if not waypoints then return end
	
	if #waypoints == 0 then

	end
	local waypoint:PathWaypoint = table.remove(waypoints,1)
	if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
		humanoid.Jump = true
	end
	humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
end
